description: Fires when the leftmost column (column 0) is exactly three stones high with an opponent stone on top, so the next stone there lands in row 4. Strongest (often 5-9) when the opponent has just played there to make three in a row up column 0 (a must-block); mixed stacks like mine-mine-theirs fire weakly and only about half the time. Vertical threes in other columns, or column 0 at other heights, do not fire.
effect: Moderately raises the probability of playing column 0 (on top of the stack), e.g. +9 to +18 points when steered to max in non-forced positions; turning it off changes little.
notes: Scores: p1 (col0 h3, top theirs) F1 0.636 R 0.91 AUROC 0.94; p2 (+>=2 theirs) F1 0.616; p3 (+ last move col0 or >=2 theirs) F1 0.646 P 0.54 R 0.81, sim share 0.50. Minimal pairs: OOO in cols 1/3/6 ~0; col0 h2 or h4 negative; perspective flips each ply. Mixed stacks are graded by board context I could not isolate (col1 stones help a bit). Some misses: OOO in col0 already capped by X in busy boards. All synthesis beat dev max (9.4-9.7).
